root_graft_family.scope: T_m with a pendant path of length 1..8 grafted at root, optionally one additional root-adjacent K1,3; m=0..8; all eligible integer ranks

support_or_center_graft_family.scope: T_m with path length 1..8 grafted at marked support or first claw center; m=0..8 (claw-center locus requires m>=1)

two_core_gluing_family.scope: T_m grafted to T_k by a path of length 1..4; m,k=0..6
